title: erigeron acris subsp. macrophyllus
intro: Erigeron acris subsp. macrophyllus, commonly known as the tall fleabane, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. Additionally, Erigeron acris subsp. macrophyllus has been used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and skin problems, due to its expectorant, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties.
